n2.text:
Gaps filled

- The prototype photo (ecosort_gl.jpeg) and the client's reference screenshots did not arrive with the brief. The project slots are labelled placeholders until the photo is uploaded.
- Home 'Latest' list uses three of the proposed article titles to show the layout. They are ideas, not published work: no dates are shown for them.
- On dark bands the button flips to surface fill with deep text, so it stays visible. Forest stays the only action colour on light ground.
- Icons are drawn to Phosphor Regular geometry as stand-ins for the package.
- Blog, Topic hub and Project related lists reuse the proposed titles, bylined 'the Revalue team'.
- Pricing: only Waste assessment has cost factors in the brief. Other rows say [Cost factors to confirm]; their status tags are my mapping to the Solutions list, to confirm.
- Toolkit 'How to use it' steps are drawn from its subtitle. Evidence source, date and method are [bracketed] for the team to fill.
- Legal pages carry 'Last updated: [date]'.
- States are Tweaks on the artboard: Home featured project, Solution status, Blog empty topic, Topic hub thin or full, Toolkit file unavailable, Projects empty filter, Article reviewed.
